items.briefing:
Australian mid-market businesses are being urged to strengthen their cyber defences, with new data showing they account for 73% of ransomware victims globally. Separately, ASIC is warning Australians about AI-generated deepfake investment scams, where criminals use realistic fake videos and personas to promote fraudulent schemes. A China-linked hacker group has also been observed using AI tools in attacks targeting the Asia-Pacific region, a reminder that threats close to home are growing more sophisticated.

A new "no-filter" AI platform called Kriminal is also raising concerns by lowering the barrier for cybercriminals to launch attacks. If you receive an unsolicited investment opportunity online — especially involving video endorsements — verify it through ASIC's website before engaging.

featured.title: Retailers widen security role beyond loss prevention
featured.summary: Security teams are increasingly being used to improve efficiency, safety and compliance as retailers seek more value from ageing systems.
